title: Jeremiah Imprisoned

questions.question: Who did Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon make king in the land of Judah instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:1 (ESV): "Zedekiah the son of Josiah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah, reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim."

questions.question: Did Zedekiah or his servants or the people of the land listen to the words of the Lord that he spoke through Jeremiah?
options: Yes, they listened but were afraid.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:2 (ESV): "But neither he nor his servants nor the people of the land listened to the words of the Lord that he spoke through Jeremiah the prophet."

questions.question: What did King Zedekiah send Jehucal and Zephaniah the priest to say to Jeremiah?
options: "Please pray to the Lord our God for us."
"Tell us when the Babylonians will leave for good."
questions.correctAnswer: "Please pray to the Lord our God for us."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:3 (ESV): "King Zedekiah sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah the priest, the son of Maaseiah, to Jeremiah the prophet, saying, 'Please pray to the Lord our God for us.'"

questions.question: Why had the Chaldean army that was besieging Jerusalem withdrawn for a time?
options: Because they heard the army of Pharaoh had come out of Egypt
Because a plague struck their camp
questions.correctAnswer: Because they heard the army of Pharaoh had come out of Egypt
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:5 (ESV): "The army of Pharaoh had come out of Egypt. And when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news about them, they withdrew from Jerusalem."

questions.question: The Lord told Jeremiah to tell the king of Judah regarding Pharaoh's army that came to help them: "Behold, Pharaoh's army... is about to return to... "
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:7 (ESV): "Behold, Pharaoh's army that came to help you is about to return to Egypt, to its own land."

questions.question: "And the... shall come back and fight against this city. They shall capture it and burn it with fire."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:8 (ESV): "And the Chaldeans shall come back and fight against this city. They shall capture it and burn it with fire."

questions.question: "For even if you should defeat the whole army of Chaldeans who are fighting against you, and there remained of them only... in their tents, they would rise up and burn this city with fire."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:10 (ESV): "and there remained of them only wounded men in their tents, they would rise up and burn this city with fire."

questions.question: When the Chaldean army withdrew because of the approach of Pharaoh's army, where did Jeremiah set out to go?
options: To the land of Benjamin to receive his portion
To Egypt to flee the approaching army
To the king's palace to warn him again
questions.correctAnswer: To the land of Benjamin to receive his portion
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:12 (ESV): "Jeremiah set out from Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin to receive his portion there among the people."

questions.question: When Jeremiah was at the Benjamin Gate, who arrested him?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:13 (ESV): "When he was at the Benjamin Gate, a sentry there named Irijah the son of Shelemiah, son of Hananiah, arrested Jeremiah the prophet,"

questions.question: What did the sentry accuse Jeremiah of doing?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:13 (ESV): "saying, 'You are deserting to the Chaldeans.'"

questions.question: Jeremiah replied, "It is a lie; I am not deserting to the Chaldeans." What did the officials do to Jeremiah?
options: They beat him and put him in prison
They let him go after warning him
They sent him to the king immediately
They cast him over the wall
questions.correctAnswer: They beat him and put him in prison
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:15 (ESV): "And the officials were enraged at Jeremiah, and they beat him and imprisoned him in the house of Jonathan the secretary,"

questions.question: When Jeremiah had been in the dungeon cells for many days, King Zedekiah sent for him and questioned him secretly. What did the king ask?
options: "Is there any word from the Lord?"
"How long will you stay in prison?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Is there any word from the Lord?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:17 (ESV): "King Zedekiah sent for him and received him. The king questioned him secretly in his house and said, 'Is there any word from the Lord?'"

questions.question: What did Jeremiah reply to King Zedekiah?
options: "There is. You shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon."
questions.correctAnswer: "There is. You shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:17 (ESV): "Jeremiah said, 'There is.' Then he said, 'You shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.'"

questions.question: Jeremiah begged King Zedekiah not to send him back to the house of Jonathan the secretary, "lest I... there."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:20 (ESV): "do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the secretary, lest I die there."

questions.question: What did King Zedekiah command they give Jeremiah daily while he remained in the court of the guard?
options: A loaf of bread from the bakers' street (until it was gone)
A bowl of soup and water
A portion of meat from the king's table
questions.correctAnswer: A loaf of bread from the bakers' street (until it was gone)
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 37:21 (ESV): "and they gave him daily a loaf of bread from the bakers' street, until all the bread of the city was gone."

key_verse_text: King Zedekiah sent for him and received him. The king questioned him secretly in his house and said, "Is there any word from the Lord?" Jeremiah said, "There is." Then he said, "You shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon."
